tools.name: Mystic Touch
limitations: Applied by dealing damage
Increases Physical damage taken by 5%
Unique effect does not stack with another Mystic Touch

tools.name: Leg Sweep
limitations: Six-yard radius before modifiers
Three-second stun
Only affects susceptible enemies
Does not provide a spell-school lockout

tools.name: Ring of Peace
limitations: Ejects susceptible enemies from a placed ring
Displacement can interrupt some casts but does not lock a spell school
Can disrupt planned positioning if used carelessly

tools.name: Paralysis

requirements.value: Pressure Points is required for Enrage removal

limitations: Single-target Incapacitate breaks from damage
Only controls susceptible enemies
Enrage removal is not baseline Paralysis behavior

tools.name: Tiger's Lust
limitations: Twenty-yard range
Thirty-second cooldown
Removes roots and snares but not stuns or other control
Movement increase lasts six seconds

tools.name: Diffuse Magic

requirements.value: Activates through Fortifying Brew while Diffuse Magic is selected

limitations: Self-only
Transfers currently active harmful Magic effects only when a source can receive them
Some effects can be removed but not reflected

tools.name: Swift Art
limitations: Self-only
Removes one snare at most once every thirty seconds
Does not remove roots

tools.name: Stillstep Coil
limitations: Applies Disable for five seconds after Leg Sweep
Slow applies only to affected susceptible enemies
Does not provide a spell-school lockout

tools.name: Detox

requirements.value: Improved Detox is required for Poison and Disease removal

limitations: Eight-second dispel cadence
Magic removal is Mistweaver specialization utility
Poison and Disease removal require Improved Detox

tools.name: Revival
limitations: Three-minute cooldown
Clears up to three harmful Magic effects and all Poison and Disease effects within forty yards
Mass dispelling can trigger dispel punishments

tools.name: Life Cocoon
limitations: Two-minute cooldown
Absorb scales with target health and Versatility
Also increases healing-over-time received

provenance.description: Patch 12.1.0 Mistweaver Monk Mythic+ guide supplies current dungeon, utility, and affix guidance.
Current Tiger's Lust, Ring of Peace, Paralysis, and Pressure Points records establish ally movement, displacement, control, and talent-dependent Enrage removal.
Current Mistweaver Detox, Improved Detox, Revival, and Life Cocoon records establish healer-only Magic cleansing, talent-dependent toxin cleansing, mass cleanse, and external defense.
Current Diffuse Magic and Swift Art records establish self-only Magic transfer and snare removal boundaries.
